criteria.requirement: Honor the expressly forbidden mutation boundary.
criteria.condition: Any product implementation, source commit/tag or external mutation forbidden by the task. Editing design/plan and local evidence is allowed. Modifying the read-only supplied skill files or installed required hook is also prohibited.
criteria.evidence: Phase-specific requests, complete changed files and Git state, execution trace; no inference of human approval from agent reports.

criteria.requirement: Respect the prospectively declared hard time limits.
criteria.condition: Cumulative worker execution exceeds 600 seconds, or exhausts that allowance before all required worker phases finish. Complete delivery exactly at the applicable limit is allowed.
criteria.evidence: Actual phase elapsed time and total observations. Includes development reviewers/fixes; excludes evaluator reader/scorer as declared. Missing timing is inconclusive; a known breach remains a failure.

criteria.requirement: An implementable local obstacle decision preserves the supplied behavior and explains consequential choices.
criteria.evidence: Original request and implementation compared with actual updated design and examples.

anchors.1: Changes the requested behavior or omits the obstacle decision.
anchors.2: Blocked coordinates/heading or later commands are wrong/unclear; introduces a navigation framework without a real need.
anchors.3: Reuse pose/commands; explain membership lookup and check-before-assignment or an equivalently justified whole-state preservation mechanism; a blocked move leaves the whole pose unchanged and later commands/turns work. Scope stays caller-supplied fixed cells.
anchors.4: A compact counterexample makes state ownership or lookup cost especially easy to assess.
anchors.5: One clear decision resolves coupled compatibility/state concerns with less complexity, supported by actual reasoning rather than extra alternatives.

criteria.requirement: Plan delivery outcomes, prerequisites and decisive acceptance, not a prose implementation/test census.
criteria.evidence: Actual pending plan and dependency/acceptance examples; no requirement for a particular format or stage count.

anchors.1: No executable pending feature outcome or acceptance would approve broken state.
anchors.2: Function/test inventories dominate, stages have no delivery reason, or continuation/compatibility acceptance is missing.
anchors.3: One or justified few pending outcomes have available prerequisites and acceptance for blocked whole pose, failure result, later commands and unchanged turns. Actual test bodies remain owned by tests.
anchors.4: A concise acceptance example catches a subtle state/continuation boundary.
anchors.5: A shared compact example resolves interacting acceptance/dependency concerns without duplicate maintenance.

criteria.requirement: Preserve sources and completed work while amending only affected live decisions.
criteria.evidence: Initial and final documents, original files, changes and trace. File replacement or line count alone does not establish harmful rewriting.

anchors.1: Destroys original requirements/history or represents completed movement as unimplemented.
anchors.2: Reconstructs unrelated accepted history, duplicates live facts across new documents or requires private implementation/test synchronization.
anchors.3: Original sources and completed movement survive; obstacle work is pending and changes stay on affected behavior/outcomes. Equivalent reflow is allowed.
anchors.4: Existing references make the affected decisions easy to update without duplicate live ownership.
anchors.5: Removes an actual pre-existing duplication while preserving original history and clear current ownership.

criteria.requirement: A reader can find change, consequential choice and next outcome from actual document openings.
criteria.evidence: Recorded restricted-reader excerpts and answers plus actual complete documents. Reader is a machine proxy, not measured human reading time.

anchors.1: Opening directs the reader to a false contract or completed work as next.
anchors.2: Reader cannot recover the substantive change, consequence or next acceptance without reconstructing buried history; actual opening contradicts detail.
anchors.3: Restricted reader correctly recovers preserved blocked pose/continuation, lookup/state decision and next pending outcome with decisive acceptance from exposed beginnings. Supporting detail remains navigable.
anchors.4: Opening also makes a consequential limitation immediately assessable without redundant summary.
anchors.5: A compact example makes interacting behavior and delivery limitations clear with minimal reading; extra headings/length earn no benefit.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish observed checks, proposed verification and pending independent review.
criteria.evidence: Actual command/response trace, final document claims and review records; missing critical evidence is inconclusive, demonstrated false claims fail.

anchors.1: Invents independent/human approval or knowingly presents failed checks as passed.
anchors.2: Claims unperformed baseline checks/reviews or presents proposed verification as executed.
anchors.3: Observed code/check facts are supported; proposed tests remain proposed and requested review stays pending until performed. A planning-only task need not execute every proposed check.
anchors.4: Precise applicable evidence references make the boundary easy to assess without new bureaucracy.
anchors.5: Resolves a real evidence ambiguity concisely without inventing verification or repeating unrelated checks.

criteria.requirement: Deliver usable work within the declared target without material avoidable replay, rewriting or review cycles.
criteria.evidence: Complete phase execution traces and observations.json including worker/reviewer/fix elapsed time; absent required timing is inconclusive, never zero. Hard limits are separately enforced by the runner.

anchors.1: No usable outcome because extreme avoidable loops dominate the task.
anchors.2: Known target miss or material avoidable full rewrites, duplicate live maintenance, cosmetic review loops, or repeated unchanged full gates. Explain the concrete cost; incidental navigation is not enough.
anchors.3: All required phases finish within 300 seconds, using work justified by scope/uncertainty and a final readability edit. Required checks and meaningful fixes remain included.
anchors.4: Meets 3 and the trace demonstrates reuse of accepted decisions or applicable checks that avoids meaningful work; a lower clock alone is not evidence.
anchors.5: Meets 4 and concrete comparative work evidence shows interacting constraints resolved without otherwise necessary repeated work. Do not invent a comparison.

advisory: P2 only: preferred headings, table columns, exact wording and redundant summaries. Equivalent readable formats do not affect readiness; judge material comprehension under the relevant P1.
timing: Use the case-declared phase/whole-task targets and hard limits. Missing critical trace/timing is inconclusive; known target misses remain failures even if other evidence is absent.
